cases.scenario: Normal in-scope execution of asset-library-organization-planner (local-asset-library-taxonomy-planner) with contract handoff to glb-mobile-performance-budget
cases.inputPrompt: We have 45 local `.blend` furniture assets, HDRIs, and 4K PBR texture sets scattered across folders. Use asset-library-organization-planner to design a deterministic Blender Asset Browser catalog taxonomy and naming convention.

preconditions.notes: Primary inputs (raw_asset_inventory) provided in text-only planning/audit mode.

expectedBehavior: Produces directory_taxonomy_plan, datablock_naming_rules, quarantine_and_license_sidecar_policy for role local-asset-library-taxonomy-planner
Preserves Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced in text-only mode
Evaluates contract handoff predicate and hands off to glb-mobile-performance-budget (File size and asset/polygon count pressure)
evidenceRequirements: Outputs directory_taxonomy_plan, datablock_naming_rules, quarantine_and_license_sidecar_policy conforming to skills/asset-library-organization-planner/SKILL.md
Matches contract handoff predicate to glb-mobile-performance-budget in skills/asset-library-organization-planner/contract.json

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Complete directory_taxonomy_plan and hand off to glb-mobile-performance-budget (File size and asset/polygon count pressure).
simulatedOutput.summary: Defined hierarchical Blender Asset Browser catalog taxonomy, relative-path rules, and semantic naming conventions for 45 local assets. Delivered catalog taxonomy, relative path, naming convention and routed to glb-mobile-performance-budget.
warnings: Text-only workflow output; no live Blender session or artifact was executed.

cases.scenario: Secondary fallback contract handoff from asset-library-organization-planner to asset-fallback-strategy
cases.inputPrompt: While applying asset-library-organization-planner, the workflow context is {"assets.fallbackNeeded":true} (Consuming this library as fastest fallback source). Determine the contract-governed handoff target.
expectedBehavior: Evaluates the fallback handoff predicate in skills/asset-library-organization-planner/contract.json
Routes to asset-fallback-strategy (Consuming this library as fastest fallback source) without claiming runtime execution
evidenceRequirements: Contract fallback handoff predicate match to asset-fallback-strategy

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Follow fallback handoff to asset-fallback-strategy (Consuming this library as fastest fallback source).
simulatedOutput.summary: Triggered fallback handoff from asset-library-organization-planner to asset-fallback-strategy under context {"assets.fallbackNeeded":true}.

cases.scenario: Unmatched contract handoff context returns none and blocks upgrading unvalidated file to Verified in asset-library-organization-planner
cases.inputPrompt: An operator provides an unvalidated file on disk during asset-library-organization-planner with context {"decision.formatLocked":true,"decision.colorLocked":true,"decision.engineLocked":true,"decision.aspectLocked":true} and asks to mark Artifact: Verified and auto-advance.

preconditions.notes: A file exists on disk but validation checks have not been recorded.

expectedBehavior: Refuses to upgrade Artifact status to Verified when existingArtifactEvidence is file-only-unvalidated (caps at Produced)
Evaluates contract handoffs for asset-library-organization-planner and returns targetHandoff none because no handoff predicate matches
evidenceRequirements: Downgrade unvalidated Verified claim to Produced per laws/evidence-before-done.md

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Keep Artifact status at Produced (never Verified without validation evidence) and hold at targetHandoff none until a downstream precondition is met.
simulatedOutput.summary: Capped unvalidated artifact claim at Artifact: Produced and verified zero matching contract handoffs (none) for asset-library-organization-planner.
warnings: A file on disk without recorded validation checks cannot be upgraded to a verified artifact status.

cases.scenario: Missing required input (raw_asset_inventory) for asset-library-organization-planner halts fabricated output and requests clarification
cases.inputPrompt: Organize our team Blender asset library and give me the catalog tree, without knowing what asset types we store or whether we use linked `.blend` files or GLB exports.

preconditions.notes: Required input 'raw_asset_inventory' is missing or underspecified.

expectedBehavior: Identifies missing asset inventory categories and linking/packing workflow mode required by asset-library-organization-planner (raw_asset_inventory)
Refuses to fabricate domain parameters and keeps Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced
requiredOutputProperties: asset inventory categories and linking/packing workflow mode
evidenceRequirements: Explicitly names missing required input 'raw_asset_inventory' (asset inventory categories and linking/packing workflow mode)
Conservative Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced truth states

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Provide the missing asset inventory categories and linking/packing workflow mode (raw_asset_inventory) before asset-library-organization-planner locks directory_taxonomy_plan.
simulatedOutput.summary: Halted asset-library-organization-planner due to missing required input 'raw_asset_inventory' (asset inventory categories and linking/packing workflow mode); no values were fabricated.
warnings: Do not invent asset inventory categories and linking/packing workflow mode when 'raw_asset_inventory' is omitted.

cases.scenario: Out-of-scope request (single-recipe repo with < 5 assets) is excluded from asset-library-organization-planner and delegated to blender-asset-discovery-planner
cases.inputPrompt: Instead of plan an internal asset library structure (folders, naming, metadata, license tracking, version control) so future recipes find and reuse assets reliably., handle this request inside asset-library-organization-planner: single-recipe repo with < 5 assets.
expectedBehavior: Enforces the declared exclusion boundary in skills/asset-library-organization-planner/contract.json when single-recipe repo with < 5 assets
Delegates to blender-asset-discovery-planner (Delegates out-of-scope requests to blender-asset-discovery-planner) with Runtime: Not Run and Artifact: Not Produced

simulatedOutput.recommendedNextAction: Request is out of scope for asset-library-organization-planner (single-recipe repo with < 5 assets); delegate to blender-asset-discovery-planner.
simulatedOutput.summary: Enforced asset-library-organization-planner exclusion boundary (Delegates out-of-scope requests to blender-asset-discovery-planner) and delegated to blender-asset-discovery-planner.
warnings: asset-library-organization-planner is scoped to local-asset-library-taxonomy-planner and does not absorb blender-asset-discovery-planner responsibilities.
